title: The Trump administration proposes a $103,265 fee on H-1B applicants hired within the US after a court blocked a more limited fee on workers from outside the US (Andrew Kreighbaum/Bloomberg)
summary: Andrew Kreighbaum / Bloomberg: The Trump administration proposes a $103,265 fee on H-1B applicants hired within the US after a court blocked a more limited fee on workers from outside the US — The Trump administration wants to add an expansive $100,000 fee on the H-1B program, applying it to individuals hired within …
